\par\smallskip\raggedright\footnotesize\textit{Source: Authors' own work.} 10 seeds $\times$ 20 target records. Target: the 43 tabular features of one training record of the actual recommender; label and sequence inputs given to the attacker (upper bound on leakage). Update: purchase-head BCE gradient on that record (batch size 1), clipped to $C=1.0$. Attack: cosine gradient matching, Adam, lr 0.05, 300 iterations, initialised at the reference mean. Cosine and success (cosine $\geq 0.5$) are measured on standardised features, where guessing the mean scores 0; MSE ratio $<1$ means better than that guess.
